_comment: Per-route MINIMUM application/ld+json block count for W2 (T-FRONTEND-REWORK-0905).
This is a FLOOR, not an exact count: the gate asserts current_count >= this value.
A DECREASE from this number is a regression and must FAIL the route (schema silently
dropped is an SEO/AEO regression). An INCREASE is fine and must PASS (adding schema is
not a defect) â€” do not tighten these to exact-match values; that was tried for the
homepage alone in an earlier version of this gate and is deliberately not repeated here
for every route, because it would fail a healthy build the moment anyone adds a
legitimate schema block, for no safety benefit over a floor.
Each entry was derived by counting this route's own <JsonLd .../> call sites in its
page component (each renders exactly one <script type="application/ld+json"> block â€”
verified at src/lib/seo/schema.ts's JsonLd() implementation, which JSON.stringifies its
whole `data` prop, object or array, into ONE script tag, never one per array item) plus
the ONE static Organization schema block baked into the base index.html template's
<head> (verified at ./index.html and reproduced in every real prerendered snapshot,
e.g. .proof-os/tasks/T-FRONTEND-REWORK-0905/facts/evidence/dist-about.HEALTHY-eac5e58.html
which carries exactly 3 = that 1 static block + about.tsx's 2 own <JsonLd> calls).
Route list is scripts/marketing-routes.mjs's PRERENDER_ROUTES (19 routes) plus every
*.md file under src/content/blog/ (7 posts, via prerender.mjs's discoverBlogRoutes()) â€”
26 routes total, matching the 26-route count this gate is scoped to.
KNOWN OPEN QUESTION, not acted on here (out of scope â€” touching landing.tsx or
prerender.mjs is explicitly not this task): every OTHER route's baseline above matches
'1 static head block + own <JsonLd> call sites' exactly against source, but '/' does
not â€” landing.tsx has 4 <JsonLd> call sites + FaqSection's FAQPage = 5, which is what's
recorded below, with no allowance for the static head block that every other route
measurably carries. If the static block also survives prerendering '/' once W1's crash
is fixed, the real healthy count may be 6, not 5. Recorded here rather than silently
changed because (a) 5 is what was explicitly specified for this baseline, and (b) it is
harmless either way under the floor semantics above: 6 >= 5 is an increase, which PASSES.
Re-derive an entry the same way (grep '<JsonLd' on the route's page component, add 1
for the static head block, cite both) if a route's schema call sites change.
If a future prerendered route is not listed here, the gate exits 2 (GATE UNAVAILABLE) and
names the unlisted route. There is deliberately NO default/fallback entry (no DEFAULT_MIN):
one was tried and was a no-op for every new route, because every route inherits 1 static
block from the template regardless of its own schema, so '>= 1' passed unconditionally.
A guessed replacement floor (e.g. 2) has the same defect at a different number â€” it would
still pass a route that should carry five blocks. The correct floor for an unlisted route
is unknown until someone derives it the same way every other entry below was derived, so
the gate must refuse to guess: adding a route breaks the build until its floor is added
here explicitly. That is the intended behaviour, not a side effect.
PRIYA 2026-09-05: homepage baseline corrected from 5 to 6, and DEFAULT_MIN removed â€” see
the KNOWN OPEN QUESTION note above, which flagged the possible +1. Re-derived: the
repo-root index.html template's 1 static block is confirmed (measured via /about, whose
baseline of 3 = 1 template + about.tsx's own 2 <JsonLd> calls, both counted with
`grep -o â€¦ | wc -l` â€” NOT `grep -c`, which counts matching LINES and undercounts on
single-line prerendered HTML). landing.tsx carries 4 <JsonLd> call sites + FaqSection's
own FAQPage block = 5 page-level blocks, +1 for the template block = 6. W3 will confirm
against the real prerendered artifact once W1's homepage crash is fixed; if the real count
disagrees with 6, W3's measurement wins and this entry gets corrected then.
